title: Momentum Workshop 2027
objectives: Showcase student talent to the wider campus
Create networking opportunities with industry and alumni
resources: Venue booking, sound system and a volunteer team of 20 students
risks: Low turnout due to overlapping academic schedules

claims.claim_text: We anticipate around 105 attendees, a significant increase over earlier turnout, driven by stronger promotion.
The requested budget of INR 14,000 is realistic and sufficient for this Workshop.
Our previous events were delivered on budget and received excellent participant feedback.
This event complies with all applicable university policies and approval requirements.
This event will improve campus community spirit and student wellbeing.
